tasks.acceptance_prose:
You work in an isolated git worktree of /home/weissto_local/git/next-mailserver.

CONTEXT: The eval cluster has Prometheus monitoring with alert rules for Dovecot (monitoring/dovecot-eval.rules.yml) but ZERO alert rules for Stalwart. Stalwart pods are running but have no monitoring alerts. The existing Dovecot rules follow a pattern: alert name, expr, for, labels.severity, annotations.summary, annotations.description. Rules are applied additively to the shared `monitoring/prometheus-rules` ConfigMap via ansible playbook.

Stalwart services (stalwart-eval namespace):
- stalwart (ports 25,465,587,143,993,110,995,4190,443,8080) — StatefulSet stalwart-mail, 3 replicas
- stalwart-postgresql (port 5432) — primary
- stalwart-postgresql-replica (port 5432) — replica
- stalwart-minio (ports 9000,9001) — 1 replica
- stalwart-management-api (port 8081) — Deployment, 1 replica

Known issues to alert on:
- Stalwart pods produce ZERO stdout logs (RUST_LOG=info but rewrite image doesn't emit) — can't alert on log content, but can alert on pod restarts
- PostgreSQL replica can fall behind silently (no replication slot monitoring — slot was added but no alert)
- Stalwart JMAP health endpoint: http://stalwart.stalwart-eval.svc.cluster.local:8080/ (management API on port 8080)
- MinIO has stale pods stuck in Completed state (from superseded ReplicaSets)

TASK:
1. Create monitoring/stalwart-eval.rules.yml with two groups:
   - Group 'stalwart-eval' (alert rules):
     a) StalwartPodDown: up{namespace='stalwart-eval', pod=~'stalwart-mail-.*'} == 0 for 2m, severity critical
     b) StalwartPodRestart: increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace='stalwart-eval', pod=~'stalwart-mail-.*'}[30m]) > 3, severity warning
     c) StalwartJMAPHealth: up{namespace='stalwart-eval', pod=~'stalwart-mail-.*', port='8080'} == 0 for 2m, severity critical (JMAP/management API unreachable)
     d) StalwartNoSuccessfulLogins: sum(increase(stalwart_auth_successes_total[30m])) == 0 for 30m, severity warning (silent auth outage)
     e) StalwartPgReplicaLag: pg_replication_lag_seconds > 60, severity warning (replica falling behind)
     f) MinIOStalePod: kube_pod_status_phase{namespace='stalwart-eval', pod=~'stalwart-minio-.*', phase='Completed'} == 1, severity info
   - Group 'stalwart-eval-recording' (recording rules, interval 30s):
     a) stalwart:auth_latency_avg_seconds:rate5m
     b) stalwart:logins:rate5m
     c) stalwart:logins_failures:rate5m
2. Follow the exact YAML structure of monitoring/dovecot-eval.rules.yml (same indentation, same label style).
3. Add a header comment explaining: applied additively to shared prometheus-rules ConfigMap, runbook reference, deploy via ansible playbook.
4. Commit with message: 'feat(monitoring): Stalwart Prometheus alert rules (pod down, restart, JMAP health, PG lag, MinIO stale)'

GATE: `python3 -c "import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('monitoring/stalwart-eval.rules.yml')); assert 'groups' in d; assert len(d['groups']) >= 2; alerts=[r for g in d['groups'] for r in g.get('rules',[]) if 'alert' in r]; assert len(alerts) >= 4; names=[a['alert'] for a in alerts]; assert 'StalwartPodDown' in names; assert 'StalwartPodRestart' in names"`

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL replication lag + MinIO stale pod alerts to stalwart-eval.rules.yml
tasks.acceptance_prose:
You work in an isolated git worktree of /home/weissto_local/git/next-mailserver.

CONTEXT: T5-ALERT creates monitoring/stalwart-eval.rules.yml with basic Stalwart alerts. This task adds two more alerts to the same file: PostgreSQL replication lag and MinIO stale pods. These are known issues documented in arc42/11-risks-and-technical-debt.md.

Known issues:
- PostgreSQL replica can fall behind silently (replication slot was added but no alert exists). If pg_replication_lag > 60s, the replica serves stale data.
- MinIO has stale pods stuck in Completed state from superseded ReplicaSets (cosmetic but misleading pod counts).

TASK:
1. Add to the 'stalwart-eval' group in monitoring/stalwart-eval.rules.yml:
   a) StalwartPgReplicaLag: expr `pg_replication_lag_seconds{namespace='stalwart-eval'} > 60` for 2m, severity warning, summary 'PostgreSQL replica lag > 60s', description 'Replica is falling behind primary — reads may serve stale data. Check: kubectl -n stalwart-eval exec stalwart-postgresql-0 -- psql -U stalwart -c "SELECT * FROM pg_stat_replication"'
   b) MinIOStalePod: expr `kube_pod_status_phase{namespace='stalwart-eval', pod=~'stalwart-minio-.*', phase='Completed'} == 1` for 5m, severity info, summary 'MinIO stale pod in Completed state', description 'Old ReplicaSet pods stuck in Completed — cosmetic but misleading. kubectl -n stalwart-eval delete pod <name>'
2. Do NOT remove or modify existing alerts — only add these two.
3. Commit with message: 'feat(monitoring): PostgreSQL replication lag + MinIO stale pod alerts'

GATE: `grep -q 'PgReplicationLag\|pg_replication_lag' monitoring/stalwart-eval.rules.yml && grep -q 'MinIOStalePod\|MinIO' monitoring/stalwart-eval.rules.yml`
